t: You're at Homerton University Hospital, a teaching hospital in Homerton, in the London Borough of Hackney. It's managed by Homerton Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust. Like any hospital it marks the beginning and end of many lives. Niyah Smith, a British music executive born in 1992, was born here. Michael Allieu, a staff nurse, died here in 2020. And Norma Ashe-Watt, a Trinidad-born British accountant and social activist, died here in 2025.
